name: sql
label: 操作业务数据库
description: Run SQL against the business database selected by data.mode (local = SQLite, mysql = remote MySQL; the config picks one, so it cannot hit the wrong database); read-only by default, writes need readOnly=false + confirmWrite=true, and dangerous statements (DROP, UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE) are blocked and audited by rules.

sql.description: 单条 SQL,如 SELECT * FROM customers WHERE tenant_id = ?

readOnly.description: read-only by default: write statements (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, ...) must pass false explicitly

confirmWrite.description: dangerous writes need true to confirm; rules block DROP/TRUNCATE/ALTER and require WHERE on UPDATE/DELETE
